title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from the previous and next pages). X is a smooth compactification, ultimately of M_{g,ν}, by a divisor Θ with normal crossings, Θ ⊃ Θ^(2) ⊃ Θ^(3) ⊃ …. For each flag d_0 > d_1 > … > d_r of codimensions, D_{d_0…d_r} is the normalized flag-stratum. V*_{D,X} is the deleted tubular neighbourhood of D. V*_{Θ,X} =: X^{*∞} is the 'structure at infinity', i.e. the deleted neighbourhood of Θ. X* = X∖Θ is the open part (the open moduli space).

The 'théorème de recollement' (p.74) says the following. The ½-simplicial (semi-simplicial) topos formed by the V*_{d_0…d_r} (all d_i > 0) maps to V*_{Θ,X}, and this map is an equivalence of topoi. In modern terms: the boundary of the real oriented blow-up (Kato–Nakayama space) is glued from the deleted neighbourhoods of the strata, which are torus-type bundles over the strata. This gives a homotopy-colimit decomposition indexed by the stratification poset. In particular it gives bijections on π_0 and equivalences on π_1 of corresponding components.

Corollary 1 (this page). Fix a flag δ = {δ_0 > … > δ_s > 0} and the stratum D_δ with its induced normal-crossings divisor Θ_δ. Then the ½-simplicial topos of the V*_{D_{d_0…d_r,δ_0…δ_s}}, with d_0 > … > d_r > δ_0 varying, is again equivalent to the structure at infinity V*_{Θ_δ,D_δ} = D_δ^{*∞}. The page writes D_δ^* here, but D_δ^{*∞} is meant. Proof: simply apply the theorem to the pair (D_δ, Θ_δ), whose strata are exactly the flags extending δ by larger codimensions.

The point for M_{g,ν}: boundary strata are again (products of) moduli spaces M_{g',ν'}. So the structure at infinity is recursive/self-similar, and every stratum carries its own structure at infinity, compatible with the gluing.

The crossed-out Corollary 2 is a first draft of what appears on p.75. Suppose X^{*∞} → X* is a 1-equivalence (bijection on π_0, iso on π_1 of corresponding components). Then the fundamental groupoid of X* is a colimit of the groupoids Π̃_{d_0} (1 ≤ d_0 ≤ 3), Π̃_{d_0 d_1}, …. The final version on p.75 uses only codimension ≤ 2: Π_1 X ≃ lim→(Π̃_1 ← Π̃_{2,1} → Π̃_2). This is the topological core of the 'Lego–Teichmüller' principle: the Teichmüller groupoid is generated by data at infinity of codimension 1 and 2.
errors: The page writes V*_{Θ_δ,D_δ} = D_δ^* at the end of Corollary 1, while earlier on the same page it is (correctly) D_δ^{*∞}. This is a slip: the deleted neighbourhood at infinity is meant, not the open stratum.

The crossed-out draft of Corollary 2 indexes over 1 ≤ d_0 ≤ 3. The next page corrects this: for Π_1 only codimension ≤ 2 matters, since Θ^(3) can be neglected by a local Van Kampen argument. Codimension 3 reappears only for higher-codimension data (the Π_3 remark in the margin).

No mathematical gap in Corollary 1 itself: it is an immediate application of the gluing theorem to (D_δ, Θ_δ). It does require that D_δ be the normalized stratum, so that Θ_δ has normal crossings. For M̄_{g,ν} this holds in the stack/orbifold sense; the page does not address this.

ideas.what: The structure at infinity of a stratum D_δ (with induced divisor Θ_δ) is the semi-simplicial gluing of the deleted neighbourhoods of the deeper flag-strata D_{d_0…d_r,δ}.
ideas.modern_name: Homotopy-colimit (stratified) decomposition of the boundary of the real oriented blow-up / Kato–Nakayama space, applied recursively to strata
ideas.usually_credited_to: Folklore of log geometry / stratified spaces; Kato–Nakayama (1999) for the log Betti realization; Harvey and Ivanov for bordifications of moduli
ideas.where_published: Only implicitly: the Esquisse d'un programme (1984) describes the 'structure à l'infini' and boundary tubular neighbourhoods without these statements.

ideas.what: Recursive / self-similar nature of the structure at infinity: boundary strata of M_{g,ν} carry their own structure at infinity, compatible with the gluing.
ideas.modern_name: Modular operad structure of the boundary of M̄_{g,n}; Teichmüller tower
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme, §§2–3 (Teichmüller tower, gluing of moduli 'à l'infini')

ideas.what: Crossed-out draft: if X^{*∞} → X* is a 1-equivalence, then Π_1(X*) is a colimit of groupoids attached to the boundary strata of low codimension.
ideas.modern_name: Van Kampen for the fundamental groupoid of the boundary; 'two-level' principle for the Teichmüller groupoid
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Esquisse); realized by Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps, Moore–Seiberg and Bakalov–Kirillov style presentations
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (the Teichmüller tower is determined by its first two levels, at the level of fundamental groupoids)

missed.claim: The page shows Grothendieck deriving the Lego/two-level principle from a precise topos-theoretic gluing theorem. That theorem is an equivalence between the semi-simplicial topos of deleted neighbourhoods of flag-strata and the deleted neighbourhood of the whole boundary, applied recursively to each stratum. The Esquisse states the principle only heuristically, so this is documentation of method rather than a new result.
missed.quote: considérons D_{δ0,δ1,…,δs}=D_δ, et le diviseur Θ_δ sur D_δ, et V*_{Θδ,Dδ}=D_δ^{*∞} (structure à l'infini de D_δ^{*∞})
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Historically it clarifies that the Lego–Teichmüller program rested on an explicit stratified Van Kampen / descent statement for topoi. Today one would phrase this via Kato–Nakayama spaces or exit-path categories. Mathematically it is routine for specialists.

deep.surprise_reason: Corollary 1 is a direct reapplication of the gluing theorem to a stratum. The surrounding ideas (structure at infinity, codimension ≤ 2 determining Π_1) are announced in the Esquisse and were later realized by Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps and others. The page has historical interest as a step in the unpublished derivation, but contains nothing new to specialists.
transcription_corrections: 'Alors le rapport [?] ½ [?] s'introduit [?] des' should read roughly 'Alors le [topos] ½ simplicial des …': it refers to the ½-simplicial topos of the theorem on p.74.
'comme lim topologique' likely reads 'a comme limite topologique' or similar, i.e. its limit topos is equivalent to the structure at infinity.
'bien [?] que [?] le th. [?] à D_δ, Θ_δ …' likely reads 'Car il suffit d'appliquer le th. à D_δ, Θ_δ …'.

Crossed-out part: 'Soit un Δ-ique [?] (i.e. induisant…' should be 'Soit une 1-équivalence (i.e. induisant des bijections pour les π_0, et les π_1 des comp. connexes correspondantes)', consistent with p.75.
Crossed-out heading: 'Corollaire 2 Supposons que V*_{Θ,X} ↪ X*', where the underlying symbols read V*_{Θ,X} =def X^{*∞} and X* = X∖Θ.
Under the subscript of V*_{D_{d_0…d_r,δ_0…δ_s}} the underbrace annotation is probably 'de degré r' or 'de longueur r', not 'de degré impair'.
